sources.publicWarning: Official Legislative Library archival download with an added catalogue cover at physical page 1; PDF-page references identify this downloaded copy. The full Board expense control is $6,566; these 10 numeric-pay observations have $5,455 known expenses, and the excluded five have $1,111 known expenses. This is a scope difference. A complete comparison replaced the 3,289-row compiled employee copy with the official employee schedule. The source excludes fiscal2024 fees paid in fiscal2025.
